uniqueness.policy: Permanent scope singleton assigns one approvedRunId and one session; no change of window/deployment/card or alternate cohort can bypass custodian approval. Never recreate a missing/restored scope without independent continuity. Transactional indexed take(2), duplicate rejection, shared scope CAS; indexes alone are not uniqueness constraints.

schemaInvariants: windowStartMs < grantDeadlineMs <= windowEndMs; windowEndMs - windowStartMs <= 1800000; all timestamps finite safe integer milliseconds

Grant fields, grantKey, sealed scope run/session assignment and principal policy digest cannot be caller-rebound; changed identity requires separate approval and is unsupported by this single-run design
Session authority expiry caps grant/read deadline; generations must match exact existing authority records on every forward transaction
runSpent, attemptSpent, rollbackArmed, fenceOpenedOnce, consumed, closed, revoked, unknown and permanentStop cannot transition true->false
fenceOpen may become true once only after rollbackArmed and attemptSpent; close/revoke/unknown prohibit reopen
consume requires fenceOpen and not consumed/closed/revoked/unknown; tombstone consumed is changed atomically with attempt consumed
operationKey recomputed from stable runKey/operation/requestNonceDigest; exact duplicate is diagnostic readback only, never read permission
receipt sequence and revision monotonically increase; safe integer exhaustion denies; commit ordering stays int64 and is never coerced to wall-clock milliseconds
every custom index query bounded take(2) for singleton paths; recovery paginated with limit <=32; duplicate rows stop scope
evidence body counters require independently verified instrumentation digest; caller-submitted zeros or status alone do not qualify evidence
